attchmntText: Brightcom Group Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Brightcom Group Ltd released an investor presentation for the half year ended 30 September 2026. Consolidated revenue for the period was Rs. 3,689.21 Cr. Profit after tax was Rs. 526.54 Cr. Earnings per share for the trailing twelve months stood at Rs. 5.18. Second quarter revenue increased by 17.38% year over year. Second quarter profit after tax rose by 13.70% year over year. The company operates through AdTech, Defence, NextGen, and Services divisions. Brightcom Defence plans to establish a demonstration facility in the United States. Strategic priorities include strengthening AdTech, building the Defence division, developing NextGen applications, growing Services, and improving cash generation. The presentation contains forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties.

attchmntText: Brightcom Group Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Brightcom Group Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated Revenue from Operations was 1,937.04 Crores for Q2 FY 2026–27 and 3,689.21 Crores for H1 FY 2026–27. Net Profit After Tax stood at 264.96 Crores for Q2 and 526.54 Crores for H1. The Trailing Twelve Months Earnings Per Share is 5.18 per share. The Board also authorized the Managing Director to establish a demonstration facility in the United States for the Brightcom Defence division. A shareholders conference call is scheduled for 18th November 2026.
